title: 水墨记忆
artDirection: Distill the source into broad ink masses, broken dry-brush edges and generous negative space. Derive palette and structural axes from the source. Do not invent scenery, people, signs or narrative facts.

title: 线条记忆
artDirection: Reconstruct two to four observable spatial relationships with broad charcoal sweeps and one continuous source-derived color gesture. Keep the composition sparse. No stock symbols, tracing, invented scenery or decorative text.
marks: charcoal sweeps and a single color gesture

title: 纸上记忆
artDirection: Distill source subjects into a small set of cut-paper masses with source-derived color, scale and overlap. Preserve the source focal hierarchy. No travel stickers, invented props, labels or stock landmarks.
